title: Nonempty Fourier coefficients of the conjunction function
statement: Let $w$ be a nonnegative integer, and define $f:\{-1,1\}^w\to\{-1,1\}$ to equal $-1$ at the all-$-1$ input and $1$ elsewhere. For every nonempty subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,w-1\}$, its Fourier coefficient with respect to uniform expectation on the cube is $\widehat f(S)=-2\cdot 2^{-w}(-1)^{|S|}$.
hypotheses_covered: The width $w$ is a nonnegative integer
The function equals $-1$ only at the all-$-1$ input and equals $1$ elsewhere
$S$ is a nonempty subset of the coordinate set
